description: A large red sandstone fortress with crenellated walls, domed towers and a gateway, with scaffolding on its towers, beside a river on the left. In the foreground, elephants with chains drag red sandstone blocks while many workers carry bricks and dig in the dirt. A rider on a brown horse wearing an ornate gold robe and a white turban, with attendants holding gold parasols, looks on beside a man in green holding a plan. Stormy sky, painted in an oil style.
